book: A 1585 Latin edition of the Heidelberg Catechism (Catechesis religionis christianae) in 129 questions in three parts, followed by appendices of Scripture sayings, prayers and rites, Zacharias Ursinus's Responsio to eighteen censures, a set of Quaestiones and Capita on the Lord's Supper, then indexes and tables.
